title: AI Release Highlights Q3 2026
summary: In Q3 2026, SAP marks a major step in delivering on the Autonomous Enterprise, with 45,000 cloud customers now using our AI solutions.
body_markdown:
This quarter marks a major step in delivering on our promise of the Autonomous Enterprise, with 45,000 cloud customers now using SAP’s AI solutions.


Help people achieve more, respond to change, and uncover new opportunities with AI from SAP


[Learn how](https://www.sap.com/products/artificial-intelligence.html)


In Q3, we expanded our portfolio of Joule Assistants and introduced dozens of specialized agents that help customers move beyond isolated tasks toward connected, end-to-end execution. The value of AI has always been about what it accomplishes for our customers. Our recent releases help them streamline processes, increase productivity, and build more resilient operations.


Joule is SAP’s portfolio-wide AI engagement layer, combining agentic capabilities with SAP business applications to help organizations become an Autonomous Enterprise. Through Joule Work, the new UI for AI, people describe what they want to achieve, get relevant insights, build app-less spaces personalized to their needs, and take action across connected business systems. When it’s time to execute, Joule Work selects the right Joule Assistant for the job. These assistants act as domain experts, bringing knowledge of roles and processes to the task at hand. They orchestrate specialized Joule Agents to execute tasks, using business context and data, respecting established authorizations, and maintaining audit trails. People set the direction, assistants coordinate agents, and agents carry out work with proper oversight and governance.


For example, billing teams can create invoices, identify anomalies, and resolve posting errors with the Billing Assistant and its agents. Supply chain planners can detect critical shortages earlier, assess trade-offs between service levels and inventory investment, and coordinate responses with the Supply Chain Planning Assistant. Maintenance teams can turn asset signals into coordinated maintenance action, helping address problems before they become larger operational disruptions. People retain oversight and control, while assistants and agents help reduce manual effort.


Customers are already putting these capabilities to work. PwC is using SAP’s Billing Assistant to help identify potential issues earlier, supporting better client outcomes. Novartis has launched a pilot of the Sourcing Assistant to help sourcing professionals focus on strategy, supplier engagement, and value creation.


“Agents bring consistency and speed to work that previously required a lot of manual effort and coordination,”[said Christoph Buerki](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4UdwT28_F7I) , head of Procurement at Novartis. He expects improvements of 25% faster cycle times and a 35% uplift in FTE productivity.


As organizations adopt more agents, they need a clear view of their AI landscape. SAP AI Agent Hub provides a central inventory of SAP and non-SAP agents, helping teams keep track of and govern their growing agent portfolio. With SAP Signavio agent mining and the Process Consulting Agent, we enable customers to identify their biggest opportunities for agentic AI and execute on them right away. This visibility supports a more coordinated approach to managing AI adoption across the business.


With Joule Studio, accessible through Joule Work, customers can create agents tailored to their business and extend SAP standard agents with their own instructions. Browser-based tools and pro-code development options support different levels of technical expertise, while testing, versioning, and deployment turn ideas into agents that take action. This lets customers extend SAP’s capabilities to meet their business requirements.


Now, let’s dive into recent innovation.


Please note that this article covers only AI offerings released since July 1, 2026.


## **Joule** ****


### **Joule Work**


Employees can spend less time navigating applications and more time turning information into outcomes with Joule Work, which is available on desktop, in-app, web, and mobile. Joule Work, the new UI for AI, connects local and cloud environments, bringing conversational AI closer to the files, information, and business tools employees use every day. Employees can work with local files and folders in a secure sandbox environment, access current information through integrated web search, and connect to SAP and non-SAP applications using Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and Agent-to-Agent (a2a) integrations. Custom and corporate skills help streamline repetitive tasks, while local data and connected tools support faster creation of presentations, summaries, and other assets. And where a skill is not enough, the SAP Knowledge Graph kicks in to search the entire space of business objects available to users for deeper transactional and analytical queries. Together, these capabilities reduce manual information analysis and help employees focus on higher-value work.


Dynamic workspaces, which we refer to as spaces, bring together insights, applications, Joule Assistants, and agents to support business workflows. Employees express what they want to accomplish, and Joule Assistants coordinate specialized agents to carry out the work. This effectively initiates the journey into a world where generative UI delivers an ultimate personalized experience to any end user. Joule Studio complements this experience with capabilities to build, deploy, and govern custom agents and workflows.


Early adopter feedback shows how this experience is changing the way employees interact with business information. Reinhausen, a global technology leader in electrical grid technologies,[joined the Joule Work desktop early](https://news.sap.com/2026/10/joule-work-sap-business-ai-platform-power-next-generation-business-ai/) adopter program to support its AI journey. “What once required up to an hour of manual effort across our SAP S/4HANA environment is now accessible in seconds through natural language, fundamentally changing how our teams interact with business data,” said Peter Wied, director of Complexity Management at Reinhausen.


Customers are[also using custom](https://news.sap.com/2026/10/joule-work-sap-business-ai-platform-power-next-generation-business-ai/) assistants to bring expertise closer to employees. Warehouse automation company KNAPP used Joule Studio to build an assistant that helps workers identify and resolve problems without waiting for an expert, reducing issue resolution times by about 90% and time spent on documentation and training by about 80%.

### **Joule Studio**


Business and IT teams can tailor Joule to their organization’s needs with Joule Studio, combining custom AI agents for complex business processes with reusable skills for everyday tasks. The agent builder enables teams to create agents that plan, reason, and dynamically address business challenges across SAP and non-SAP systems. These agents can coordinate multi-step processes, invoke APIs, work with documents, and collaborate with users or other agents, helping organizations handle ambiguity, exceptions, and workflows that go beyond predefined automation.


The skill builder complements these capabilities with reliable, reusable operations accessed through Joule’s conversational interface. Teams can create skills to retrieve specific data, execute system transactions, and connect SAP and third-party applications using predefined logic. Joule can select and trigger relevant skills based on context, helping employees complete frequent tasks more efficiently.


New intent-based development capabilities draw on business context from SAP Signavio, SAP Knowledge Graph, and SAP Domain Models, helping teams translate business needs into tailored solutions. Pro-code capabilities let developers work in their preferred IDE, Git repository, and AI coding tools.


Together, the two builders help organizations combine flexible, goal-driven agents with predictable, task-specific automation. Grounding agents in business data and processes supports reliable outcomes, while centralized management provides visibility into skills, agent execution, and data privacy enforcement. Joule Studio helps customers build agents faster, improve accuracy while reducing costs, deploy with built-in governance, and ground AI in their business context. Estimated benefits include a 35% reduction in the time to build and deploy custom Joule Agents and a 10% reduction in the time to deploy custom Joule skills, alongside less time spent on frequent business tasks.


The agent builder is available for free until December 2026, after which it becomes a premium AI feature. The skill builder is a base AI feature.


Learn more[here](https://help.sap.com/docs/joule-studio) . Get started[here for skills](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-feature/e93aa292-e7f4-449d-9586-f1a8510d5ab6/) and[here for agents](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-feature/c95490eb-95c3-4b0a-b9ea-08144355d482/) .

### **SAP Joule for Consultants, AI-assisted custom knowledge benchmarking**
Generally available


SAP consultants can use custom knowledge grounding in SAP Joule for Consultants to receive expert guidance that combines SAP-curated content with system connectivity for an organization’s institutional knowledge. Through a grounding service that indexes organizational content with SAP AI Core grounding, surfacing relevant information from internal documents into the Joule workflow. This way, responses reflect the firm’s methodologies, policies, delivery standards, and domain expertise. This reduces time spent searching and switching between tools while supporting growth in knowledge sources over time; it can improve productivity by up to 19%, reduce design iterations and subsequent rework by 50%, increase the share of profit by 1.5% through more optimized SAP processes, and accelerate time to realized value by 13.7%.


Customers are already seeing the value of SAP Joule for Consultants.[Wipro](https://www.sap.com/asset/dynamic/2025/11/3a43e7f9-2b7f-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html) reports a 40% reduction in development effort and a 25% decrease in software rework, helping its consultants focus more on innovation and client delivery.[SEIDOR](https://www.sap.com/asset/dynamic/2025/07/b22e092c-107f-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html) expects to reduce consultant training time by 20 to 30% and save 93 hours each week on information searches, enabling consultants to build expertise faster and spend more time addressing clients’ business challenges.

## **Autonomous SCM**


### **Product Design Assistant**


- **Change Record Management Agent**
- **Product Data Maintenance Agent**
- **Product Structure Optimization Agent**


Design engineers and product managers can bring products to market faster and avoid costly rework with the Product Design Assistant. It connects data across design, engineering, compliance, and downstream processes, analyzing designs, recipes, and product information to surface insights. It also flags issues early and checks materials and requirements against internal rules and regulations. Three agents released in Q3 strengthen the foundations of product development. Engineers can keep product master data accurate with the Product Data Maintenance Agent, while the Product Structure Optimization Agent consistently optimizes bills of material across product views to reduce costs. When designs need to be changed, the Change Record Management Agent identifies similar change records affecting the same product and proposes a new draft version to initiate the change process. This reduces delays caused by fragmented change data and improves governance and traceability.


The result is faster, more confident design decisions and higher product quality, with estimated benefits including a 19% reduction in product design costs, a 10% increase in prototype success, a five percent reduction in cost of goods sold from design improvements, and a 12% reduction in tooling and material waste costs.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/5f26ac8e-9e68-46aa-a352-b760de40a88d/) .


The general availability for Product Design Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Logistics Assistant**


- **Batch Optimization Agent**
- **Warehouse Workload Optimization Agent**
- **Fixed Bin Maintenance Agent**
- **Material Reservation Processing Agent**


Warehouse and logistics teams can keep operations running smoothly from inbound shipments to outbound deliveries with the Logistics Assistant. It senses disruptions as they happen and coordinates detection, planning, and execution across warehousing and transportation, managing decisions on labor, inventory, dispatch, and freight. Four agents released in Q3 focus on warehouse execution. Supervisors can match staff to demand and spot potential resource shortages early with the Warehouse Workload Optimization Agent. The Fixed Bin Maintenance Agent adjusts bins and replenishment as demand changes. On the inventory side, the Batch Optimization Agent monitors batch expiration and triggers actions to reduce waste. The Material Reservation Processing Agent lets users manage material reservations in natural language, with built-in human review. Together, these capabilities shorten the time from plan to execution, improve resilience to disruption, and lower the cost to serve by reducing expedites and inventory waste.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/674e9dc6-1b69-4cd2-9ed1-76b2251dabc6/) .


The general availability for Logistics Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Manufacturing Assistant**


- **Production Planning and Operations Agent**
- **Production Master Data Readiness Agent**
- **Production Planning Order Progress Agent**
- **Workplace Safety Agent**


Production planners and plant operators can keep manufacturing on track and respond to disruptions sooner with the Manufacturing Assistant. It detects issues in real time and runs corrective workflows for quality, scheduling, and workforce management. It also recommends next-best actions with clear pros and cons, so operators can focus on the exceptions that matter most.


Four agents released in Q3 support production from preparation through execution. The Production Master Data Readiness Agent makes sure materials are fully ready for production without manual setup, and the Production Planning Order Progress Agent identifies coverage issues at every order level. To speed up order-to-delivery, the Production Planning and Operations Agent helps planners release orders in as little as half the time. On the shop floor, the Workplace Safety Agent lets workers report safety concerns by describing what they observe, then assesses risks and suggests actions based on the situation and past data.


By coordinating people, systems, and workflows toward shared operational goals, the assistant helps reduce downtime, waste, and safety response times while supporting compliance through built-in traceability. Estimated benefits include a 14% reduction in production cycle time, a 19% reduction in scrap and defect rates, a six percent reduction in changeover time, a 10% reduction in operating income lost to unplanned downtime, and a 10% reduction in energy costs.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/071c3ce4-e11b-4dd8-bfd9-180f83d4c0f8) .


The general availability for Manufacturing Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Supply Chain Planning Assistant**


- **Exception Management Agent**
- **Inventory Investment Allocation Agent**
- **Supply Chain Planning Orchestration Agent**


Supply chain planners can detect issues earlier and respond to change with confidence using the Supply Chain Planning Assistant. It brings AI agents into everyday planning work, including exception management, demand fulfillment, inventory assessment, and capacity analysis, with one-click scenario simulation, root-cause analysis, and actionable recommendations. Three agents released in Q3 help planners turn analysis into action. The Exception Management Agent detects and resolves critical supply planning issues, giving planners the insights they need to protect service levels and avoid costly expedites. The Inventory Investment Allocation Agent weighs service levels against working capital to recommend optimal stock targets. The Supply Chain Planning Orchestration Agent coordinates these and other specialized agents across planning workflows. By speeding up decisions and surfacing capacity issues and persistent shortages in advance, the assistant helps planners keep schedules and inventory targets on track, with estimated benefits including a 20% reduction in planning coordination overhead and a 10% reduction in planning cycle time.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/6a08e602-3c69-449c-b0f3-e8c84c23cd5e) .


The general availability for Supply Chain Planning Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Asset Operations Assistant**


- **Operational Maintenance Planning Agent**
- **Maintenance Event Planning Agent**
- **Maintenance Request Initiation Agent**
- **Maintenance Job Debrief Agent**
- **Equipment Insight Agent**
- **Task List Management Agent**


Maintenance teams can identify critical asset conditions earlier and resolve them before they turn into larger operational disruptions with the Asset Operations Assistant. It turns asset signals into coordinated maintenance action and automates prioritization, planning, and scheduling, leaving teams more time for high-value work and exceptions.


Six agents released in Q3 cover the maintenance cycle from first request to final debrief. Technicians can create and route maintenance requests from natural-language input with the Maintenance Request Initiation Agent, while the Equipment Insights Agent provides a complete view of equipment to support better decision-making. The Operational Maintenance Planning Agent combines preventive, predictive, and corrective tasks into executable weekly and biweekly plans. When conditions change, the Maintenance Event Planning Agent analyzes real-time data to reprioritize tasks and adjust schedules. The Maintenance Task List Management Agent automates task list creation for greater consistency, and the Maintenance Job Debrief Agent streamlines job debriefs with AI-driven recommendations. By connecting asset health, risk, work outcomes, and financial impact, the assistant helps organizations increase planned work, reduce unplanned downtime, and improve uptime.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/9261f306-f329-43e3-a284-296fb2f42ae3) .


The general availability for Asset Operations Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **SAP Integration Business Planning, AI-assisted scenario planning**


Supply chain planners can respond to disruptions with confidence using scenario planning in SAP Integrated Business Planning. Within one workspace, they can assess impacts on demand and sales orders, identify alternative supply sources, and simulate mitigation options against KPIs such as service level and utilization before adopting the best-performing scenario. This streamlined approach helps planners make faster, data-driven decisions, build trust in their plans, and strengthen supply chain resilience.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-feature/58333cea-4364-414f-b408-dc892123c753/) .


This capability is generally available.


## **Autonomous HCM**


### **HR Service Assistant**


- **HR Knowledge Agent**
- **HR Workflow Accelerator Agent**
- **Payroll Explanation**
- **Time Off Service Agent**
- **Time Sheet Service Agent**
- **HR Service Orchestration Agent**


HR service teams can resolve routine employee requests conversationally, without creating a case each time, using the HR Service Assistant. The assistant provides always-on support and draws on six agents released in Q3. Employees get fast, cited, policy-grounded answers from the HR Knowledge Agent, while the HR Service Orchestration Agent resolves requests through self-services or routes them to the right specialist agent. Common everyday questions are handled directly in the conversation: the Payroll Explanation Agent clarifies pay statements, and the Time Sheet Service Agent and Time Off Service Agent guide employees through submitting timesheets and creating compliant leave requests. When processes stall, the HR Workflow Accelerator Agent identifies delays and resolves them, allowing HR teams to reserve expert attention for complex cases. Estimated benefits include a 24% increase in case deflection to self-service, a 26% reduction in time to resolution, and a 40% reduction in queries that need Tier 2 or higher intervention.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/4382318a-ea9c-459d-958c-c95c83305838/) .


The general availability for HR Service Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **HR Operations Assistant**


- **Employee Data Integration Agent**
- **Position Optimization Agent**
- **Job Change Request Agent**
- **Compensation Guidance Agent**
- **Job Architecture Maintenance Agent**
- **Skills Governance Agent**


HR teams and managers can simplify core HR administration while keeping employee, job, and organizational data consistent and compliant with the HR Operations Assistant. Six agents released in Q3 help connect these activities: managers can find, edit, and create positions with the Position Optimization Agent and translate their intent into job changes with the Job Change Request Agent, while the Compensation Guidance Agent recommends policy-aligned salary increases based on performance, compensation, and skills data. To maintain the underlying data, the Employee Data Integration Agent resolves data inconsistencies, while the Job Architecture Maintenance Agent and Skills Governance Agent help keep role–skill mappings current and the skills ecosystem clean and AI-ready. Working alongside the assistant’s other specialized agents, they reduce administrative effort and support more reliable HR processes, with estimated benefits including a 39% reduction in data errors, a 20% reduction in HR transactional work, and a 25% reduction in manager time on core HR workflows.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/1e8417ec-6984-4af8-ada2-7fa28cd1cfb8/) .


The general availability for HR Operations Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Performance and Goals Assistant** ****


- **Calibration Equity Agent**
- **Goal Creation Agent**
- **Goal Progress Agent**


Managers and HR teams can align employee goals with business strategy and bring greater consistency to performance evaluations using the Performance and Goals Assistant. Three agents released in Q3 contribute to its broader capabilities: the Goal Creation Agent generates SMART performance goals grounded in strategy and role context; the Goal Progress Agent tracks completion in real time and flags risks before deadlines are missed; and the Calibration Equity Agent identifies potential inconsistencies in employees’ performance ratings before or during calibration. By combining clearer goals, proactive progress monitoring, and insights into rating inconsistencies, the assistant helps managers conduct more efficient reviews and make better-informed calibration decisions, with estimated benefits of a 21.4% reduction in review completion time and a 30% reduction in manual decision-making effort for managers.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/c2a78567-07b4-4d85-8a75-8ba98150f1ba/) .


The general availability for Performance and Goals Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **HR System Assistant**


- **Configuration Transport Agent**
- **HCM Audit Agent**
- **Role-based Permissions Agent**


HR administrators can resolve access issues, manage configuration changes, and keep systems audit-ready with the HR System Assistant. It automates low-risk tasks and guides higher-risk changes, helping reduce errors and accelerate go-lives. Its Q3 releases address three key administrative needs: the Configuration Transport Agent discovers, bundles, and securely migrates configuration changes across tenants; the HCM Audit Agent enables natural language queries of SAP SuccessFactors audit logs; and the Role-Based Permissions Agent queries user access, helps fix permission issues, and automates secure access resolution. As part of the assistant’s broader capabilities, these agents support faster troubleshooting, fewer configuration defects, and stronger traceability, with estimated benefits of a 70% reduction in configuration transport effort, a 90% reduction in time spent generating audit reports, and a 90% reduction in permission incident resolution costs.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/6a4a72ea-29f1-4683-ae97-59ba62feaa1d/) .


The general availability for HR System Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


## **Autonomous Finance**


### **Billing Assistant**


- **Billing Posting Agent**
- **Billing Creation Agent**
- **Billing Anomaly Agent**
- **Billing Adjustment Agent**
- **Error Explanation and Resolution Agent**
- **Billing Orchestration Agent**


Billing teams can improve invoice accuracy and resolve issues faster with the Billing Assistant, which coordinates activities from document creation through adjustments and posting support. There are six agents being released in Q3: teams can prioritize due lists and create policy-aligned billing documents with the Billing Creation Agent, while the Billing Anomaly Agent flags unusual taxes and charges for review. When errors arise, the Billing Posting Agent and the Error Explanation and Resolution Agent help teams understand the issues and identify corrective steps, while the Billing Adjustment Agent cancels and reissues invoices to apply adjustments. The Billing Orchestration Agent coordinates these activities to keep billing processes moving. Together, these capabilities reduce manual effort and support faster invoice correction and dispute resolution, with estimated benefits including a 90% reduction in time spent analyzing and resolving posting issues, a 70% reduction in billing document creation effort, a 70% reduction in anomaly detection effort, and a 54% reduction in invoice reprocessing effort.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/c2af7b30-3f8b-4651-b63b-3f193d0dc05d/) .


The general availability for Billing Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Financial Closing Assistant**


- **Journal Entry Agent**
- **Accounting Accruals Agent**
- **Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent**
- **Analytical Business Insights Agent**
- **Asset Accounting Anomaly Detection Agent**
- **Financial Consistency Analysis Agent**
- **Financial Closing Orchestration Agent**


Finance and accounting teams can accelerate period-end execution with the Financial Closing Assistant while controlling the extent to which agents participate in journal postings, clearing, and analysis. Seven agents released in Q3 support connected closing activities: teams can streamline audit-ready journal processing and accruals management with the Journal Entry Agent and Accounting Accruals Agent, and identify clearing opportunities through AI-based matching and aging analysis with the Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent. The Asset Accounting Anomaly Detection Agent and Financial Consistency Analysis Agent help improve accuracy by preventing invalid asset postings and resolving data errors, while the Analytical Business Insights Agent turns financial KPI analysis into executive summaries. Coordinating these workflows, the Financial Closing Orchestration Agent helps keep activities moving across teams and agents. This approach supports a faster, more reliable close, with an estimated 35% increase in productivity for staff performing reconciliations and adjustments.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/355d68c3-f86c-4e99-afab-7283a2e6f618/) .


The general availability for Financial Closing Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Cash and Treasury Assistant**


- **Cash Positioning Agent**
- **Bank Relationship Agent**
- **Cash and Treasury Orchestration Agent**


Treasury teams can manage liquidity more confidently and lower financing and banking costs with the Cash and Treasury Assistant. It monitors internal funding positions and needs, proposes cash transfers between bank accounts, and identifies ways to streamline bank wallet share and fees. Three agents released in Q3 support this work. The Cash Positioning Agent optimizes cash and performs cash-positioning tasks, such as checking balances, forecasting cash flows, and transferring funds. The Bank Relationship Agent gives treasurers a comprehensive view of the enterprise’s banking relationships, and the Cash and Treasury Orchestration Agent coordinates these activities with the assistant’s other specialized agents. Better interest yields and lower financing costs can free up funds for growth initiatives. Estimated benefits include a 50% increase in cash management and treasury staff productivity and a 10% reduction in bank commissions and fees. Productivity is also estimated to rise by 30% in the following areas: liquidity management and cash forecasting, FX risk and hedging, bank relationship management, and treasury reporting and compliance.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/47b652f0-94f4-4de1-a087-df1bcd0990d4/) .


The general availability for Cash and Treasury Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Financial Consolidation Assistant**


- **Financial Consolidation Data Submission Agent**
- **Financial Consolidation Orchestration Agent**


Consolidation teams and local accountants can complete the financial close faster and with less manual effort using the Financial Consolidation Assistant. The assistant supports work across data preparation and consolidation. It guides users through issue resolution, simplifies master data maintenance, and speeds up simulations of mergers, FX changes, and other business scenarios. Two agents released in Q3 make the close cycle smoother. Local accountants can automate data submissions and resolve errors before data reaches group consolidation using the Financial Consolidation Data Submission Agent. The Financial Consolidation Orchestration Agent coordinates its agents. Teams spend less time collecting and correcting data and more time analyzing results, with an estimated 25% increase in productivity for staff performing reconciliations and adjustments.


Get started[he](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/56d96ff1-2175-4276-bfa2-80ee841b0fa3/)[r](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/56d96ff1-2175-4276-bfa2-80ee841b0fa3/)[e](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/56d96ff1-2175-4276-bfa2-80ee841b0fa3/) .


The general availability for Financial Consolidation Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Sales Operations Assistant**


- **Billing Block Resolution Agent**
- **Credit Block Resolution Agent**
- **Delivery Issue Resolution Agent**
- **Supply Issue Resolution Agent**


Sales teams can keep orders moving and address fulfillment obstacles directly in their workflow with the Sales Operations Assistant. It automates sales order creation from unstructured data and supports order updates, shortening processing cycles and reducing errors. Four agents released in Q3 target common sources of delay: teams can address billing and credit blocks with the Billing Block Resolution Agent and Credit Block Resolution Agent, tackle delivery issues with the Delivery Issue Resolution Agent, and identify, analyze, and receive recommended solutions for supply problems with the Supply Issue Resolution Agent. By combining faster issue resolution with accurate, up-to-date sales data, the assistant helps improve customer satisfaction and support informed pricing decisions, with estimated benefits including a 15% reduction in revenue lost to fulfillment issues, a 10% reduction in financial losses from stockouts, and a 50% reduction in time spent resolving billing blocks and credit issues.


Get started[h](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/10cc5d3d-d756-43ff-9a96-e1535635613a/)[e](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/10cc5d3d-d756-43ff-9a96-e1535635613a/)[re](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/10cc5d3d-d756-43ff-9a96-e1535635613a/) .


The general availability for Sales Operations Assistant is now underway in a phased approach.


### **Recurring Receivables Assistant**


- **Collection Insights Agent**
- **Convergent Invoicing Execution Agent**
- **Subscription Lifecycle Agent**


Finance teams can accelerate collections and manage high-volume recurring receivables more efficiently with the Recurring Receivables Assistant. Supporting recurring billing and subscription-based business models, it brings customer account context, risk insights, and recommended next steps into order-to-cash activities. Three agents released in Q3 help teams act on these insights: collectors get collection support from the Collection Insights Agent, while the Convergent Invoicing Execution Agent automates invoice corrections through geography-aware, regulation-compliant rebilling. The Subscription Lifecycle Agent complements these activities by automating subscription contract management from search through execution. Together, these capabilities help protect revenue, reduce downstream corrections, and free blocked cash, with estimated benefits including a 20% reduction in controllable days sales outstanding, a 20% increase in accounts receivable staff productivity, and a 10% reduction in controllable write-offs.


Get started[here](https://discovery-center.cloud.sap/ai-assistant/76f0ada2-d9ce-4fa6-bb31-8d82edff6cc2) .


The Recurring Receivables Assistant is available in the SAP Early Adopter Care program.


### **Accounts Receivable Assistant**


- **Collection Account Preparation Agent**
- **Dispute Resolution Agent**
- **Dunning Insights Agent**
- **Collections Email Outreach Agent**
- **Dispute Creation Agent**
- **Receivable Account Analysis Agent**
- **Accounts Receivable Orchestration Agent**


Accounts receivable teams can prepare more effective collection calls and release disputed cash sooner with the Accounts Receivable Assistant. Seven agents released in Q3 connect account analysis, customer outreach, and dispute handling: collectors can build a complete customer account picture and prioritize their next steps with the Receivable Account Analysis Agent, Collection Account Preparation Agent, and Dunning Insights Agent, while the Collections Email Outreach Agent automates correspondence for worklist items that do not require a call. The Dispute Creation Agent manages dispute cases using natural language processing and provides insights, while the Dispute Resolution Agent validates cases and suggests actionable solutions. ### **Generative AI hub enhancements**


**SAP-RPT-1.6**
SAP-RPT-1.6, now available on generative AI hub, is our latest model in the SAP-RPT family. It delivers the strongest gains in prediction quality to date, particularly for high-cardinality classification, and is validated across 197 real-world enterprise tasks.


- **Explainability:** Available in all SAP-RPT-1.6 variants, this includes column-level feature importances and the ability to surface specific historical rows most influential to each prediction, giving business users and decision-makers a clearer basis for trusting and acting on AI-driven outputs.
- **Deep Context Mode:** Only available in SAP-RPT-1.6-large, this allows the model to draw on significantly larger reference datasets to improve prediction quality. It is intended for use cases with large historical data, such as invoice records spanning multiple fiscal years or product catalogs in the tens of thousands. This mode trades higher latency and cost for higher accuracy, and can be enabled via a single parameter in the prediction configuration.


**Tabular Orchestration**
Tabular Orchestration, now available on generative AI hub, is a new managed workflow for SAP-RPT models. It handles context management and data access, thereby removing the need to build and maintain custom data pipelines. Teams register their data source and scenario configuration once at design time. Every inference is a single API call, with the workflow automatically handling data ingestion and context selection before routing the prediction request to the specified SAP-RPT model. This setup is designed to easily carry forward as the workflow expands to support additional tabular foundation models beyond SAP-RPT in future releases.


**Prior Labs’ TabPFN-3.5-Plus**
Business analysts and AI teams can turn structured business data into actionable predictions faster with TabPFN-3.5 Plus, now available in SAP AI Core. Developed by Prior Labs, an SAP company, the tabular foundation model helps organizations predict outcomes such as payment delays, supplier risks, customer churn, and upsell opportunities—without task-specific model training or tuning. Unlike large language models, which excel at language and knowledge tasks, TabPFN-3.5 Plus is purpose-built for the rows and columns that underpin critical business decisions.


The model works with data as it exists in business systems, handling missing values, mixed data types, and inconsistent fields without preprocessing. Through in-context learning, it uses labeled examples to make predictions from raw tabular data, including columns containing thousands of distinct values, such as product codes or customer identifiers. This reduces the manual preparation and trial-and-error configuration associated with traditional machine learning, helping teams move from business data to predictions in minutes.


For customers, this means a faster path to predictive insights with less model-development effort. Finance teams can anticipate payment delays, procurement teams can assess supplier risks, and customer-facing teams can identify churn risks and upsell opportunities. By making prediction more accessible, TabPFN-3.5 Plus helps organizations use their structured data to inform decisions and act earlier on emerging risks and opportunities.
